entities.name: Asser Thorkilsson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Asser Thorkilsen, a son of Thorkil (Svend) Thrugotsen and his wife Inge, was the Bishop of Lund from 1089, and then the first Archbishop of Lund from 1104 until his death.
